description: The ultimate BMX race machine, co-designed by #1 ABA Pro, Robert MacPherson. Check out the totally new RM-series frame, featuring super-light, oversized 7005 heat-treated aluminum tubes with our all new extra-stiff rear triangle featuring "TwinJet" stays and "ICT" internal chain tensioner. Available in Polished Aluminum with Ferrari Red dagger. What strikes fear into the hearts of men? MX 9.2PRO
